description: Error reporter daemon. Every 86400s: reads mesh_events WHERE event_type IN (build_failed,build_generation_failed,smoke_fail,signal_drift_detected,assessment_quality_issue) AND created_at > now()-24h. Groups by event_type and agent_id. Counts occurrences of each failure pattern. ws_query corrections for recent entries. Writes ERROR_REPORT.md with: summary table, top 5 recurring failures, correction actions taken, trend vs previous day. ws_write summary stats to mesh_events. Heartbeat.
